text.name: Snivy
text.flavor: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

text.name: Snivy

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

text.name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

text.name: Servine

attacks.name: Wring Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

text.name: Serperior

attacks.name: Leaf Storm
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from each of your {Grass} Pokémon.

text.flavor: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

text.name: Serperior

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Royal Heal
abilities.text: At any time between turns, heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leaf Tornado
attacks.text: Move as many {Grass} Energy attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

text.name: Pansage
text.flavor: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

text.name: Simisage

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

text.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage and heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

text.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Leaf Storm
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from each of your {Grass} Pokémon.

text.flavor: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

text.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

text.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Constant Rattle
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 10 damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 30 damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 60 damage.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

text.name: Deerling

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

text.name: Sawsbuck

attacks.name: Nature Power
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each {Grass} Energy attached to both your and your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Horn Leech
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

text.name: Tepig
text.flavor: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

text.name: Tepig

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

text.name: Pignite

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a {Fire} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

text.name: Pignite

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

text.name: Emboar

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all {Fire} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

text.name: Emboar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Inferno Fandango
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a {Fire} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

text.name: Pansear
text.flavor: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

text.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Flame Burst
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

text.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

text.flavor: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

text.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

text.flavor: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

text.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

text.name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blue Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 {Fire} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

text.name: Oshawott
text.flavor: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

text.name: Oshawott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

text.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

text.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Aqua Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 10 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

text.name: Samurott

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

text.name: Samurott

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

text.name: Panpour
text.flavor: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

text.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Scald
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

text.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

text.name: Ducklett
text.flavor: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

text.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Feather Dance
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of this Pokémon's attacks does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

text.name: Alomomola
text.flavor: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

text.name: Alomomola

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

text.name: Blitzle
text.flavor: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

text.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

text.flavor: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

text.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

text.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Electrispark
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

text.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Stun Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

text.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

text.name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Electroweb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

text.name: Zekrom

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bolt Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.

text.flavor: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

text.name: Munna

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream Eater
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

text.name: Musharna

attacks.name: Hypnotic Ray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream Eater
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

text.name: Woobat
text.flavor: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

text.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Attract
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

text.flavor: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

text.name: Venipede
text.flavor: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

text.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

text.name: Scolipede

attacks.name: Steamroller
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

text.name: Solosis

attacks.name: Cell Culture
attacks.text: Search your deck for Solosis and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

text.name: Duosion

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon and heal all damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

text.name: Reuniclus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

text.name: Timburr
text.flavor: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

text.name: Timburr
text.flavor: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

text.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Bulk Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of this Pokémon's attacks does 20 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

text.name: Throh

attacks.name: Circle Throw
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Storm Throw
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

text.flavor: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

text.name: Sawk
text.flavor: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

text.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

text.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

text.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Krookoroll
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 40 more damage.

text.flavor: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

text.name: Purrloin
text.flavor: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

text.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Taunt
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sucker Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any {Darkness} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

text.name: Scraggy
text.flavor: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

text.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Spit Acid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

text.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

text.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Foul Play
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

text.flavor: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

text.name: Vullaby

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

text.name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: Does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Punishment
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

text.flavor: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

text.name: Klink

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

text.name: Klang

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Gear Grind
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

text.name: Klinklang

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shift Gear
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a {Metal} Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gear Grind
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

text.name: Patrat
text.flavor: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

text.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

text.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

text.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Pickup
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

text.flavor: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

text.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

text.flavor: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

text.name: Herdier

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

text.flavor: It loyally follows its Trainer’s orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

text.name: Stoutland

attacks.name: Odor Sleuth
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can’t attack during your next turn.

text.flavor: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

text.name: Pidove

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

text.flavor: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

text.name: Tranquill

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

text.name: Unfezant

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent’s next turn.

text.flavor: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

text.name: Audino

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

text.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

text.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

text.name: Bouffalant

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

text.name: Bouffalant

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent’s attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

attacks.name: Head Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
